text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
I did it... I did it~!! I won 1st place, 
Trainer!!

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
Standing in the center of the Winning 
Live, Falco sparkling and shining...!

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
You were watching closely, right?! How was 
it? How was it?
choice_data_list: You were the cutest thing out there!
You were the cutest thing out there!

I realized we can't let our guard down 
from here on either.

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
You were watching closely, right?! How was 
it? How was it?
choice_data_list: You were the cutest thing out there!
You were the cutest thing out there!

I realized we can't let our guard down 
from here on either.

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
Still... Falco isn't satisfied at all just 
yet~

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
Come on, Trainer-san. Tell me I'm "cute" 
more, and moooore, okay?
choice_data_list:
Whoa... getting a bit carried away, are 
we?

Ah... You're really getting into the 
groove, aren't you?

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
Heh-heh, too late to notice now! I'm 
riding this high all the way today☆

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
Laughing with all my heart, rejoicing. 
Savoring every single moment of the races 
and concerts—

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
"I want to make this a precious scene on 
Falco's journey to becoming a top umadol, 
after all♪"

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
"We can't let our guard down from here on 
out... Yeah, Falco thinks so too!"

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
"What Falco is aiming for is to be a top 
umadol who won't lose to anyone."

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
I have to keep winning again and again so 
I never have to give up the center spot!
choice_data_list: I believe you can do it, Falco!

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text: I'm so happy...! Thank you, Trainer-san☆

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
"In order to live up to Trainer, who 
believes in Falco――"

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
To live up to the fans' feelings, I'm 
gonna try way, waaay harder♪
